turns.prompt_text: how do you get old tape off of a window
turns.response_html: Try applying heat with a hairdryer to soften the residue, then use a plastic scraper or razor blade (keeping it flat) to gently remove it. For remaining sticky residue, use a solvent like rubbing alcohol, WD-40, cooking oil, Goo Gone, or white vinegar, letting it sit for a few minutes before scrubbing it away.
